# TogglePresent

> TogglePresent is a macOS menu bar app that prepares a Mac for presentations, demos, and screen sharing in one click. Flipping the toggle hides desktop icons, mutes the speaker, disables notifications, minimizes all open windows, and switches to a clean wallpaper. Flipping it again restores everything exactly as it was.

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later, Apple Silicon and Intel
- Type: menu bar utility (lives in the macOS menu bar)
- Price: $4.99 one-time payment, lifetime license, all future updates included
- No subscription, no account required
- Privacy: no data collection, no analytics, no telemetry — everything runs locally on the Mac

## Features

1. Hide desktop icons — instantly clears every icon from the desktop
2. Disable notifications — silences all notification banners and alerts
3. Mute speaker — cuts audio output with one click
4. Minimize active apps — sends all open windows to the dock
5. Change wallpaper — switches to a neutral or branded wallpaper for presenting

Each feature can be enabled or disabled individually; the menu bar toggle flips all chosen features at once and restores them afterward.

## How it works

1. Download the DMG and drag TogglePresent to Applications
2. Activate with the license key sent by email after purchase
3. Configure which features to toggle
4. Click the menu bar icon before presenting; click again to restore
